name: @adatechnology/player-test-area
description: Player area for the shared test room: the room's camera is the game-player body, so walking and running spend and restore stamina and make footstep noise; the bench hurts, bites, grabs and knocks the player down, switches the individual infection (off by default, a normal world) and sets the sheet, and shows health, stamina, bleeding, wounds, the infection stage, panic and the aim spread.
